---
title: Expense reimbursement
department: finance
status: current
---
Northwind reimburses reasonable expenses incurred while working. The test is
whether the expense would survive being read aloud in a team meeting, which is a
more useful standard than a list of permitted categories.

Claims are submitted in the expense tool within sixty days of the expense date. A
claim submitted later is declined by the tool and requires a manager override
with a written reason, which the finance team samples during the monthly review.

Every claim needs an itemised receipt. A card statement line is not a receipt
because it shows the amount but not what was bought. Where a receipt is genuinely
unavailable the claimant records a missing receipt declaration, and more than two
declarations in a quarter triggers a conversation with the manager.

Standard mileage for a personal vehicle is reimbursed at the published rate per
kilometre and covers fuel, wear and insurance. Parking and tolls are claimed
separately with receipts. Fines of any kind are never reimbursed, including a
parking fine incurred while making a delivery.

Meals are reimbursed when an employee is away from their usual base overnight or
for more than ten hours. Alcohol is not reimbursed. Where a meal is claimed for
a group, the claimant names every attendee on the claim.

Approved claims are paid with the next payroll run. A claim approved after the
payroll cutoff waits for the following run, and finance cannot make an off cycle
payment for an expense claim of any size.

Disputed declines are reviewed by the finance duty manager within five business
days. The reviewer looks at the policy as written rather than at custom, because
a team that has quietly been claiming something for years does not make it
claimable.
